court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court, Tiruppur and H.M.O.P.No.101 of 2022
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2016 and have two minor female twins. The petitioner is seeking to withdraw the case from Family Court, Tiruppur and transfer it to Sub-Court, Panruti.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer proceedings to a more convenient jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: Considering the distance and the difficulties faced by the wife, the Supreme Court has allowed the transfer petition.
cited_cases: Mona Aresh Goel vs. Aresh Satya Goel, (2000) 9 SCC 255
Geeta Heera vs. Harish Chander Heera, (2000) 10 SCC 304
Lalita A.Ranga vs. Ajay Champalal Ranga, (2000) 9 SCC 355

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the grant of interim maintenance without an application.
legal_principles.held: Even in the absence of any application, the Court can consider the grant of interim maintenance and

legal_principles.principle: The interest of the minor child is to be protected by the Courts.
legal_principles.held: Whenever a minor child is with the custody of the unemployed mother, even in case if the mother is employed, the father is liable to maintain the minor child and the Courts will not allow the father to shift his responsibility of maintenance of the minor child.

outcome.final_order: The transfer petition was allowed and the case was transferred to Sub-Court, Panruti.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in Family Court
